title: Market conditions
purpose: Risk appetite, volatility and energy set the mortgage SPREAD, which is the half of your rate that Treasuries do not explain.
question: Is the market calm or stressed?
how_to_read: Watch the two crude benchmarks together. Brent is the global read and WTI the domestic one. When they diverge, the story is supply or shipping abroad, not US demand. Oil is the one input here that pushes mortgage rates BOTH ways at once: up through inflation expectations, down through recession risk.

sources.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
sources.caveat: These are SPOT prices, not front-month futures. Spot and the futures screen you see on CNBC can differ by a dollar or more, and spot publishes with a lag while futures are live. Do not use this to time anything intraday.

sources.name: MRIT derived
